Brain Damage After Using
Poppers
I've had a horror experience using this drug.
Tinnitus as well as vertigo for the last year. There is a buzzing in my head that is driving me crazy - Suicidal.  [Brand name redacted] Marketing doesn't return my emails when I asked what was inside it.
I'm sensitive to white light, I can't sleep properly. I'm literally in torment day and night.
